title: Angry Lands, Brave Adventurers, and Other Decks for Vorthos

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker said to hate Garruk Wildspeaker.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker said to hate Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A dangerous plane where humanoid adventurers battle the plane's own lands and where vampires pursue their own goals.

entities.name: Adventurers of Zendikar
entities.description: Hardy humanoid explorers who brave Zendikar's wilds chasing treasure and mana-rich sites.

entities.name: Zendikar's lands
entities.description: The plane's lands, angry at plundering adventurers, which awaken and attack.

entities.name: Vampires of Zendikar
entities.description: A third force on Zendikar whose heritage stretches back hundreds or thousands of years; they hunt by stealth and believe they were once oppressed.

entities.name: Bloodchiefs
entities.description: Powerful vampires who command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires and are the only ones who can sire new vampires.

entities.name: Nulls
entities.description: Strange faceless thralls created when a lesser vampire drains a victim.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A gloomy vampire-haunted continent of Zendikar that people stay out of.

entities.name: Avenger of Zendikar
entities.description: A huge monster tied to Zendikar's land.

entities.name: Archon of Justice
entities.description: An Archon from Eventide that rides a winged white stag.

entities.name: Archon of Redemption
entities.description: A Worldwake Archon riding a mystical flying lion.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Plane with cervins ridden by elves and surreal Elementals.

relations.note: Bloodchiefs command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires
relations.quote: Powerful vampires such as bloodchiefs possess overwhelming power and can command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires

relations.note: Only bloodchiefs can sire new vampires on Zendikar
relations.quote: On Zendikar at least, only bloodchiefs can sire new vampires

relations.note: Guul Draz is a gloomy continent of Zendikar
relations.quote: part of the reason you just stay out of regions such as Guul Draz
